profile.Name: White Eyebrow
profile.Job: Leader of the White Eyebrow Clan
profile.Personality: A brave, white-haired man who abandoned his duties and took up banditry.
profile.Backstory: The United Cities wants him for abandoning his duties. It holds him responsible for last year's Brown Drought and says his uprising left its citizens a whole week without cactus rum. He leads the White Eyebrow Clan, and recent attacks are reported in the northern swamplands.
